item.title: Melania Trump Offers a Sharp Response to the Media's Latest Unusual Focus
Top Democrats stay quiet after McCarthy's decision to remove Swalwell from intel panel is validated
item.description: Democrats had backed Eric Swalwell while Republicans raised concerns about Fang Fang; newly released FBI files are now shedding more light on the situation.

item.title: Nonprofits linked to Singham resist House subpoenas, likening probe to McCarthy-era 'witch hunt'
item.description: Breakthrough News and People's Forum accuse the House Ways and Means Committee of McCarthyism over subpoenas connected to Neville Roy Singham's network.

item.title: VP JD Vance delivers rapid-fire TikTok critique of Mamdani, El-Sayed, AOC, and Ossoff
item.description: In a quick TikTok video rating politicians, Vice President JD Vance labeled Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez a 'communist' and Adam Schiff 'irrelevant.'
